summary.plain: The scientific collaboration for CMB-S4: researchers in 19 countries who defined the experiment's science. After the funding agencies ended the construction project in 2025 it continues as an independent organization.
summary.technical: CMB-S4 Science Collaboration, one half of CMB-S4 (the other being the joint DOE/NSF construction project); spans 19 countries and 26 US states; independent of the project, which DOE and NSF stopped supporting on 9 July 2025.
